mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.0% for three consecutive months, weak labor market conditions suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal contracting consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of interaction-triggered periods, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production recovery (INDPRO above 100 for two consecutive months), supply chain normalization boosts manufacturing output and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 yields negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of INDPRO recovery periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained retail sales growth (RSAFS above 12-month moving average) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of RSAFS growth periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of inflation-triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing household income and consumer confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of interaction-triggered periods, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery (UNRATE above 6.5% but declining), fragile labor market conditions lead to cautious corporate investment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 yields positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of post-recession recovery periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
